rows.label: qst703203_msg0001
rows.name:
Phew... Man, I thought
that was the END for me.

rows.label: qst703203_msg0002
rows.name: Thank you for saving me!

rows.label: qst703203_msg0003
rows.name:
You've sure got an appetite. I'm
not sure where you put all that...

rows.label: qst703203_msg0004
rows.name:
Heheh... My stomach's
never let me down!

rows.label: qst703203_msg0005
rows.name:
I love spicy food. The more I eat,
the more energy I get!

rows.label: qst703203_msg0006
rows.name:
Ugh... Just hearing about it makes
my stomach...

rows.label: qst703203_msg0007
rows.name:
...Hey, Rita! If you think
you can laugh it off, you
don't know me very well!

rows.label: qst703203_msg0008
rows.name:
Can you even imagine what
would've happened if these
guys weren't here to help?

rows.label: qst703203_msg0009
rows.name: Aww... I'm sorry, Kaede...

rows.label: qst703203_msg0010
rows.name:
Um, Rita-san... I think Kaede-san
is just worried about you.

rows.label: qst703203_msg0011
rows.name:
You're that important to her as
her Driver.

rows.label: qst703203_msg0012
rows.name: Kaede-chan... Is that true?

rows.label: qst703203_msg0013
rows.name: Let's head for that big tree next.

rows.label: qst703203_msg0014
rows.name: You ignored meee...

rows.label: qst703203_msg0015
rows.name:
Anyway, don't collapse on the road
again... or else...

rows.label: qst703203_msg0016
rows.name: I'm naming this place Rita Oasis.

rows.label: qst703203_msg0017
rows.name: ...Huh? Naming?

rows.label: qst703203_msg0018
rows.name: Erm...

rows.label: qst703203_msg0019
rows.name: Shin, do something..

rows.label: qst703203_msg0020
rows.name: ...Sorry. This is beyond me.

rows.label: qst703203_msg0021
rows.name:
What is that, some kind
of punishment?

rows.label: qst703203_msg0022
rows.name: Naturally.

rows.label: qst703203_msg0023
rows.name:
The clumsy legend of the rookie
Driver who collapsed on the road
will be passed down for ages!

rows.label: qst703203_msg0024
rows.name:
Stop it! That's way
too embarrassing!

rows.label: qst703203_msg0025
rows.name: Wait, Kaede-chan! Wait for meee!

rows.label: qst703203_msg0026
rows.name: Thanks, Hikari. You saved me.

rows.label: qst703203_msg0027
rows.name:
Thanks for pointing that out so
accurately!

rows.label: qst703203_msg0028
rows.name: ...? What are you talking about?
